No issues. `-g` is added only when no `-g` or `-g:` option is present, so a user's `-g:none` or `-g:lines` wins, and the test covers it. It doesn't affect #14338's structure check either: the local-variable tables are inside `Code`, which is dropped, apart from `<clinit>` (see my comment on #14338).

One note for the description: neither build plugin forwards its debug setting, so a build with Gradle `options.debug = false` or Maven `<debug>false</debug>` still gets `-g` here. That's not a regression, since javac's default already differed from `-g:none`, but "a build that passes `-g:none` keeps it" holds only where the option is forwarded.
